_comment: F1 — the structured venue object added to sanity/schemas/documents/nationalShow.ts.
This is THE single source for every venue-derived value the site renders. See
venue-single-source.golden.md for the rule and its verification.
Placement: immediately after the existing 'location' field, before 'hero', so an editor
sees the legacy display string and the structured object adjacent to each other.
The existing fields (title, showDate, location, hero, countdownDate, exhibitorStages,
salesOpen) are NOT modified, reordered or removed — location only gains a description.

existingFieldChanged.name: location
existingFieldChanged.change: description added only — type, name and position unchanged
existingFieldChanged.description: Short one-line display string used in the show landing-page hero. The authoritative venue detail lives in the Venue object below — keep the two consistent when the committee confirms the venue.

newObjectType.name: showVenue
newObjectType.title: Show Venue
newObjectType._comment: A named object type, not an inline object, so it can be referenced from a future exhibitor/programme document without duplicating the shape. Registered in sanity/schemas/index.ts alongside portableText under the Objects group.

fields.name: name
fields.title: Venue Name
fields.description: Full venue name as a visitor would read it, e.g. the convention centre's official name.

fields.name: addressLines
fields.title: Street Address Lines
fields.description: One entry per printed address line, in order. Do not include city or postal code here.

fields.name: latitude
fields.title: Latitude
fields.description: Decimal degrees. Used only to build a map link — no maps SDK is loaded.

fields.name: mapsUrl
fields.title: Map Link
fields.description: Link-out to a map of the venue, opened in a new tab. Any provider. No API key is used.

fields.name: mapImage
fields.title: Static Map Image
fields.description: Optional. A static map screenshot or venue location graphic, uploaded here. Leave empty to show the map link on its own — never a broken embed.

fields.name: mapImageAlt
fields.title: Static Map Image Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the map for a screen-reader user, e.g. the venue's position relative to a named landmark. Required whenever a static map image is set.

fields.name: directionsNote
fields.title: Directions Note
fields.description: Free-text arrival guidance — which entrance to use, where to be dropped off, landmarks to look for.

fields.name: phone
fields.title: Venue Switchboard
fields.description: General venue enquiries. NOT an emergency number — emergency contacts live on Show Visitor Information.

newFieldOnNationalShow.name: venue
newFieldOnNationalShow.title: Venue
newFieldOnNationalShow.description: The single source for every venue detail the website shows. Changing the venue means editing this object — nothing in the code needs to change.

_comment: F6 — the three fields whose absence forced the landing page to keep hardcoding.
Commit 32f3b0f (2026-08-06) explicitly deferred these as 'a content-model decision for
Brad/committee, not something to route around here'. F1 IS that content-model pass, so
the decision is made here. See show-identity-wiring.golden.md.

showEndDate.name: showEndDate
showEndDate.title: Show End Date
showEndDate.description: The last day of the show. A single showDate cannot express a date range, which is why the hero's Dates cell stayed hardcoded.
showEndDate._comment: showDate itself already exists and is already queried at page.tsx:48 — it is simply used by nothing. This is the missing half, not a replacement.

edition.name: edition
edition.title: Edition Number
edition.description: e.g. 19 for the nineteenth show. Rendered as a roman numeral in the hero eyebrow and used in the closing call-to-action.

hostRegion.name: hostRegion
hostRegion.title: Host Region
hostRegion.description: The host province or region, shown in the hero meta grid.

notAdded.cycle: The hero's 'Cycle: Triennial' cell stays hardcoded on purpose — it is a standing fact about how the show is constituted, not a per-edition value, and a field for it would be a field nobody ever edits.

prohibited: Removing or renaming nationalShow.location — contracts/checks/cms-loop-f3-national-show mutates it in a verified live round-trip check.
Adding a venue-name default or initialValue in the schema — seeding is the seed script's job, and an initialValue would silently re-appear in a new document.
Any coordinate, address or venue-name literal in a component or page file.
